findings.observed: data_sent OP-02 and data_received OP-08 counters materialize zero; no valid op throughput verdict

findings.reason: Sparse and absent series can receive threshold status without evidence; lab qualification is absent

findings.required: Gate nonempty A and >=100 B observations; retain real status acceptance, lab facts and full-window identity

findings.reason: Payload-size throughput is sampled before HTTP acceptance
findings.observed: Rejected PATCH/part/single-shot can contribute apparent payload throughput; server single protocol counters also include finalization via shared UploadFileAction
findings.required: Measure accepted operation bytes and durations separately from failed response counts; preserve throughput floors and expose finalization-counter overlap

findings.reason: Tier-S accessible-node query exceeds PostgreSQL total bind limit
findings.observed: HTTP 500 from root children; SQLSTATE HY000 number of parameters must be between 0 and 65535. whereKeyInChunked ORs groups of 900 into one prepared statement without reducing the total bind count. Owner grant reaches >100000 nodes. Documents folder exists (5000 documents), but setup receives 500 and silently produces an empty docs pool.
findings.required: Separate package-core corrective R27: bounded, type-safe visibility query supporting bigint and ULID; preserve auth and cursor semantics; PG regression above65535 binds plus deny/cursor checks; no mutation run

routing: R03 harness corrective, R27 package-core bind-limit corrective, then new qualified R03 window before R04
